title: Huawei smartwatch 2 as a collector from blucon via xdrip
body:
Dear all

I have a sample for 3 days of huwaei smartwatch 2. Is there a way to achieve the watch to work as a standalone collector from blucon via xdrip withoutt having a mobile phone with android wear working? This watch have a cellurar connectivity and i have placed the data card....for your info

comments.body: I have the same issue with blucon.

Someone on the FB page of xdrip+ has had success with the blucon huawei watch2 setup. Im not sure how, but he claims it works as a collector. Might want to check that out, but I am hoping for #374 personally
Closing as all the updates for this are on #374
